text: Song of ascensions. From the depths I called thee, O Jehovah.
O Jehovah, hear to my voice: thine ears shall be attentive to the voice of my supplication.
If thou, Jehovah, shalt watch iniquities, O Jehovah, who shall stand?
For with thee, forgiveness; so that thou shalt be feared.
I waited for Jehovah, my soul waited, and I hoped for his word.
My soul for Jehovah more than they watching for the morning: they watching for the morning.
Israel hoped for Jehovah: for with Jehovah is mercy and great deliverance.
And he will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
